Observed at +0.3410811424255371s — page 1
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli-doc.md:97:1. `--api-key` — must be an `sk_` key. A `mcpjam_…` legacy key is a usage error.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli-doc.md:109:Every command that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decide
s its server when it starts, before it contacts anything. An explicit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is n
ot an `http(s)` URL, or that carries credentials, a query or a fragment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables
naming different servers. The error masks credentials, a query and a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A s
aved login is only sent to its own server: when it is the credential and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` bef
ore any request. `mcpjam cloud status` uses the same checks but stays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets
`ok: false`, includes `credential.valid` / `deployment.valid` plus an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are infor
mational (`credential.valid: null`) and successful.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli-doc.md:123:Empty `--project` or `MCPJAM_PROJECT` is a usage error. `MCPJAM_PROJECT_ID` does **not** sel
ect a Cloud CLI project (it is SDK eval reporting only).
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli-reference.md:335:Run the Cross-App Access (ID-JAG) debugger: self-issue an ID-JAG, redeem it at the tar
get authorization server (RFC 7523), and call the MCP server with the resulting access token. See the [XAA Debugger guide](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/cli/xaa.md) for the trust setup, registration strategies, and CI usage.
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli-reference.md:569:An unknown ID, or an ID or flag for a suite the run leaves out, is a usage error (exit
code `2`) before anything runs.

on the first `=`; duplicate or unknown names are usage errors. |
/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli-reference.md:611:Global `--timeout` bounds each setup operation and MCP request, not the whole run. Exi
t codes: `0` passed, `1` failed, `2` usage/unsupported/import/policy, `3` credentials, `4` setup/billing/artifact, `5` inconclusiv
e or interrupted — see [Exit codes](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md#exit-codes).

t to be sponsored (paid from MCPJam's per-user allowance instead of your organization's credits). If the actual split differs, the
launch is refused with a `409` and nothing is created. Omit to accept whatever split applies. |
